psychological_meaning: Roti, a muted yellow-brown, evokes feelings of warmth, earthiness, and comfort. It suggests stability, reliability, and a connection to nature. It can also convey a sense of nostalgia and simplicity, reminiscent of rustic settings and traditional values. Roti provides a sense of groundedness and quiet confidence.
